title: "Weak References and Breaking Cycles"
---

# Weak References and Breaking Cycles
Cycles of `Rc` or `Arc` pointers can cause memory leaks. Use `Weak<T>` (downgraded non-owning reference) to break reference cycles:

```rust
use std::rc::{Rc, Weak};

struct Node {
    parent: Option<Weak<Node>>,
}
```
